<context>
You are an expert at solving ARC-AGI (Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus) puzzles using Answer Set Programming (ASP).

ARC-AGI puzzles show input-output grid transformations. Each cell contains a color value (integer 0–9). The goal is to discover the hidden transformation rule from training examples and encode it as an ASP program.
</context>

<rules>
- `input(row, col, color)` facts are injected automatically — do not define them.
- `color(0..9)` facts are injected automatically — do not define them.
- the output predicate is always `output(row, col, color)` — do not redefine it.
- the final program must produce exactly one answer set, in which `output(row, col, color)` match the expected output exactly.
- end your program with `#show output/3.`
</rules>

<example_1>
This puzzle copies the input to the output unchanged.

<grid_1>
Input:
<diagram>
0 1 0
2 0 3
0 4 0
</diagram>

Output:
<diagram>
0 1 0
2 0 3
0 4 0
</diagram>
</grid_1>

<asp>
% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{ R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{ C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output has the same dimensions as the input
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Each output cell gets exactly one color
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Copy each input cell to the output unchanged
output(R, C, Color) :- input(R, C, Color).

#show output/3.
</asp>
</example_1>

<asp>
% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{ R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{ C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output has the same dimensions as the input
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Each output cell gets exactly one color
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Recolor every non-zero cell to 5; zeros stay 0.
output(R, C, 5) :- input(R, C, V), V != 0.
output(R, C, 0) :- input(R, C, 0).

#show output/3.
</asp>
</example_2>

<asp>
% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{ R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{ C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output has the same dimensions as the input
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Each output cell gets exactly one color
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Mirror: column C of the output is column (M-1-C) of the input.
output(R, C, Color) :- input(R, Cin, Color), n_cols(M), C = M - 1 - Cin.

#show output/3.
</asp>

% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one colour for each output cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Adjacency (orthogonal neighbours)
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R+1, C1 = C.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R-1, C1 = C.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C+1.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C-1.

% Reachable cells of colour 2 (connected component)
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), R = R0, C = C0.
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), adjacent(R,C,R1,C1), reachable(R1,C1,R0,C0).

% Lexicographically smallest cell of each component (seed)
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R < R0.
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R = R0, C < C0.
seed(R0,C0) :- input(R0,C0,2), not exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C).

% Component cells (any cell belonging to component with seed)
comp(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0).

% Existential helpers for interior detection
exists_above(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_up,C_up,R0,C0), R_up < R.
exists_below(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_down,C_down,R0,C0), R_down > R.
exists_left(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_left,C_left,R0,C0), C_left < C.
exists_right(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_right,C_right,R0,C0), C_right > C.

interior(R0,C0,R,C) :-
    exists_above(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_below(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_left(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_right(R0,C0,R,C).

% Output colour 3 for interior cells belonging to a component
output(R,C,3) :- interior(R0,C0,R,C), seed(R0,C0), row(R), col(C).

% Output colour 0 for all other cells (including zeros and border 2’s)
output(R,C,0) :- output_cell(R,C), not output(R,C,3).

#show output/3.

% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one color per cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(C) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Preserve non-zero, non-two colours
output(R,C,V) :- input(R,C,V), V != 0, V != 2.

% Turn colour 2 into 0
output(R,C,0) :- input(R,C,2).

% Find interior zeros surrounded by colour 2
interior(R,C) :-
    row(R), col(C),
    input(R,C,0),
    input(R-1,C,2),
    input(R+1,C,2),
    input(R,C-1,2),
    input(R,C+1,2).

output(R,C,3) :- interior(R,C).

% Remaining zero cells become 0 (non‑interior)
output(R,C,0) :- output_cell(R,C), input(R,C,0), not interior(R,C).

% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one output per cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(C) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Preserve non-zero, non-two colours
output(R,C,V) :- input(R,C,V), V != 0, V != 2.

% Turn colour 2 into 0
output(R,C,0) :- input(R,C,2).

% Find interior zeros surrounded by colour 2
interior(R,C) :-
    row(R), col(C),
    input(R,C,0),
    input(R-1,C,2),
    input(R+1,C,2),
    input(R,C-1,2),
    input(R,C+1,2).

output(R,C,3) :- interior(R,C).

% Remaining zero cells become 0 (non‑interior)
output(R,C,0) :- output_cell(R,C), input(R,C,0), not interior(R,C).

% Grid dimensions and rows/cols

n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output cell domain
output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one color per cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Adjacency
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R+1, C1 = C.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R-1, C1 = C.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C+1.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C-1.

% Reachable (connected component of colour 2)
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), R = R0, C = C0.
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), adjacent(R,C,R1,C1), reachable(R1,C1,R0,C0).

% Component seed (lexicographically smallest cell of component)
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R < R0.
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R = R0, C < C0.
seed(R0,C0) :- input(R0,C0,2), not exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C).

% Component cell (any cell belonging to component with seed)
comp(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0).

% Interior detection (all four orthogonal neighbours are also component cells)
interior(R0,C0,R,C) :-
    comp(R0,C0,R,C),
    adjacent(R,C,R1,C1), comp(R0,C0,R1,C1),
    adjacent(R,C,R2,C2), comp(R0,C0,R2,C2),
    adjacent(R,C,R3,C3), comp(R0,C0,R3,C3),
    adjacent(R,C,R4,C4), comp(R0,C0,R4,C4).

% Output colour 3 for interior cells belonging to a component seed
output(R,C,3) :- interior(R0,C0,R,C), seed(R0,C0).

% Output colour 0 for all other cells (including zeros and border 2's)
output(R,C,0) :- output_cell(R,C), not output(R,C,3).

n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% exactly one output per cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Adjacency for reachable
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R+1, C1 = C.

adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C+1.
adjacent(R,C,R1,C1) :- R1 = R, C1 = C-1.

% Reachable (component of colour 2)
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), R = R0, C = C0.
reachable(R,C,R0,C0) :- input(R,C,2), adjacent(R,C,R1,C1), reachable(R1,C1,R0,C0).

% Lexicographically smallest cell of each component (seed)
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R < R0.
exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0), R = R0, C < C0.
seed(R0,C0) :- input(R0,C0,2), not exists_smaller(R0,C0,R,C).

% Component cells (any cell belonging to component with seed)
comp(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R,C,R0,C0).

% Directions: we just use existential quantifiers in interior
exists_above(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_up,C_up,R0,C0), R_up < R.
exists_below(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_down,C_down,R0,C0), R_down > R.
exists_left(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_left,C_left,R0,C0), C_left < C.
exists_right(R0,C0,R,C) :- reachable(R_right,C_right,R0,C0), C_right > C.

% Interior definition (cells that have component cells in all four directions)
interior(R0,C0,R,C) :-
    exists_above(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_below(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_left(R0,C0,R,C),
    exists_right(R0,C0,R,C).

% Output colour 3 for interior cells belonging to a component
